about_the_game:
🐾 BARKOUR

Step into the paws of THUNDER, a highly trained special agent… who also happens to be a very good boy!

In this fast-paced action-platformer, you’ll combine stealth, acrobatics, and gadgets to complete missions your way — sneaky and smart or bold and chaotic. All set in a world where elite agents walk on four legs and villains tend to underestimate THE DOG. Big mistake.

🐶 THE GAME

You're not just saving the day — you're doing it with style, snark, and a tail that won’t stop wagging.

Meet Agent THUNDER — the world’s most agile canine secret agent. Smart(ish), loyal, and absolutely unstoppable when equipped with high-tech gadgets and a bone to pick with evil.

Together with his grumpy-but-helpful AI sidekick A.L.F.-RED, THUNDER tackles missions his way: stealthy and slick or loud and proud. Whether you sneak through shadows or bounce off rooftops mid-chase, BARKOUR gives you the freedom to play your way.

🐾 FEATURES

🐕 Become the Bark Knight:
Blend stealth, speed and barkour to outsmart villains and complete missions your way. Each mission offers multiple approaches, so you're free to improvise — or cause chaos.

🎯 A Dog with Flow:
Jump, slide, bounce and bark your way through stylish levels full of verticality, secrets and movement challenges. It’s all about rhythm, agility, and that perfect leap.

🧨 Unleash the Gadgets:
From smoke grenades to jetpacks, swap out gear on the fly and upgrade your loadout with tools that are as stylish as they are effective. Looking cool is part of the mission.

🌍 Sniff Out Secrets:
Explore diverse, stylized environments — from high-tech rooftops to shady amusement parks. You’ll find hidden paths, bonus challenges, secrets and Easter eggs around every corner.

🐶 SUMMARY

BARKOUR isn’t just about saving the day — it’s about doing it with flair, fun, and a wagging tail. Whether you’re in it for the acrobatics, the action, or just some good old-fashioned canine chaos — THUNDER’s got your tail covered.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX Vega 56
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: BARKOUR is a fast-paced stealth-action platformer where you play as Agent THUNDER — a tail-wagging canine 009 with a knack for parkour, gadgets, and barking at villains. Join a secret animal organization to stop evil schemes in a world full of chaos and charming absurdity.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
